attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elias stood by the cot, the thin blanket draped over Constance.","severity":"major","reason":"The caravan was lost in the blizzard; nothing says her body was recovered and brought home."},{"span":"the same fabric she wore when she taught in Midworld","severity":"minor","reason":"Embellishes her backstory and treats 'Midworld' as a named place."},{"span":"the way she faced the blizzard","severity":"minor","reason":"Implies Elias saw or knows how she faced the storm; the briefing does not say."},{"span":"The letter from Ada, still tucked into her bedside drawer","severity":"minor","reason":"Invented detail about where the letter is kept."}],"voice":3,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"It meets the length and ends on a clear resolve, but placing Constance's body on a cot contradicts the lost caravan.
